svg.title: Agent OS prototype system flow
svg.desc: User and cloud planner feed an agent runtime on the phone, which calls a broker that enforces tokens and flow policy, consults an on-device model for untrusted content, and acts through adapters to Google services, Latch, and a card issuer.
svg.text: Purple: models that propose. Teal: code that enforces. Dashed: untrusted input.
Not shown: inbound typed questions from other Deputies also arrive at the broker (Phase 3).
